messages:
sara (release-ops): Heads up: we're seeing a spike of 503s from the embeddings service in eu1 since 01:48 UTC. Impacting search relevance and customer-facing features. Need a hotfix deploy slot and expedited approval.
releasebot: deploy queued by @sara for service=embeddings env=prod region=eu1 image=embed-service:v2025.12.01-fix slot=02:10UTC. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/embeds-eu1
releasebot: Canary plan: 10% traffic for 5m -> metrics checkpoint (p50/p95 latency, 503 rate). Auto-rollback threshold: 503 increase >0.5% absolute OR p95 > 1.5s above baseline.
mike (oncall): Oncall +1 to expedite, this is customer-facing. I'm standing by for the canary window. Verified current traffic pattern.
olivia (eng): Confirmed fix in staging (kvcache eviction path). Patch diff: https://gh/internal/embeds/PR/4321. Load-tested 5k rps with no 503s. Suggest pinning image to v2025.12.01-fix-embed-kv.
sara (release-ops): Need explicit approvals for fast-track. @mike @olivia can we get thumbs? This will skip the normal 30m hold.
mike (oncall): +1 from me. I'm monitoring infra metrics.
olivia (eng): +1. I ran the `curl` smoke that reproduces the error and it's gone. Command used: 
```
# smoke repro
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://eu1.api.redwood/embeds?model=embed-v2" -d '{"input": "test"}' | jq '.'
```
sara (release-ops): Noted. We'll request expedited deploybot escort. Also preparing release note blurb for ops and support. Link: https://docs/internal/releases/embeds-eu1-2025-12-01
releasebot: @sara requested deploy-escort. Please confirm operator ack and QA. To proceed, react with :white_check_mark: or reply `proceed`.
mike (oncall): react :white_check_mark: — proceeding.
olivia (eng): proceed. Leaving monitoring hooks live (traces + canary alert).
sara (release-ops): Kicking canary at 02:10UTC. Pinning version `v2025.12.01-fix-embed-kv` for this rollout. Rolling out to 10% first. If stable, we'll hit 50% then 100% within 20m.
deploy-bot: STARTING canary rollout for embeds@prod:eu1 image=v2025.12.01-fix-embed-kv. Step=1/4 (10%). ETA=02:15UTC.
releasebot: Checklist: changelog updated, stakeholders notified (support,ops,platform), rollback runbook linked. Sarah has toggle keys for immediate cutback.
mike (oncall): Watching metrics now. One abnormal tail spike at +0.12% 503s but below rollback threshold.
olivia (eng): Observability hook shows reduced KV miss. No new errors in logs.
sara (release-ops): Proceeding to 50% in 5m if metrics stable. Anyone object?
mike (oncall): no objections.
releasebot: Step 2/4 applied: 50% traffic. Monitoring window open (5m). Auto-rollback policy active.
deploy-bot: HEALTHCHECK summary: p50=48ms p95=190ms 503_rate=0.03% (baseline 0.05%). No regressions.
ops-note (sara): Temporary note for support: "Deploying hotfix for embeddings in eu1. If customers report changed vector distances, rollforward will be blocked until regression evals pass."
mike (oncall): After 5m, metrics look steady. No customer escalations.
olivia (eng): Running a quick regression eval on evaluation prompts. All within tolerance.
sara (release-ops): Rolling to 100% now. Leaving a 10m observation window post-full rollout for QA.
deploy-bot: Step 4/4 applied: 100% traffic. Rollout complete at 02:31UTC.
releasebot: Hotfix deployed and pinned. Release note: "embeds: fix kvcache eviction causing intermittent 503s in eu1; pinned image v2025.12.01-fix-embed-kv; rolled out with canary and automated rollback guards."
mike (oncall): Marking as resolved from oncall perspective. Will watch for 30m and then close incident.
olivia (eng): I'll open a follow-up PR to add a unit test around the eviction path.
sara (release-ops): Thanks team. Closing expedited approval thread. Postmortem task created: https://go/internal/tasks/ENG-EMBEDS-4321
releasebot: NOTE: If any new 503s spike >0.5% or releasebot detects latency regression, automated rollback will trigger and you will be notified in this thread.
